notes.title: Letter From The Dev
notes.notes:
[p][b]Dear fans of [i]Countryballs: The Heist[/i],[/b][/p][p]The release of [i]Countryballs: The Heist [/i]has been postponed to the [b]third quarter of 2026[/b].
Instead of quietly changing the release date on Steam, I want to personally explain what’s behind this decision and give you an up-to-date peek behind the scenes.[/p][p][/p][p][b]From an idea to the biggest project of my life[/b][/p][p]When PWA first approached me with the idea of collaborating, my answer was clear: [i]Heck yes! [/i]We wanted to create a funny Countryball game that would reflect your beloved Countryball universe as faithfully as possible, while also honoring PWA’s legendary [i]Heist [/i]series on YouTube.[/p][p]What began as chats on Discord turned into sketches. From sketches came a prototype, and from the prototype emerged the vision of a serious video game:
A strategic stealth game with a gripping storyline, sprinkled with PWA’s trademark humor, representing [b]ALL [/b]countries – not only through their flags but also via cultural references in gameplay and in countless skins. Plus, a fully-featured editor that lets you share your own Countryball stories with friends all around the world – in true meme spirit.[/p][p]And honestly, that’s just a fraction of what’s currently in the works.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Independent, without a AAA budget – but with full commitment[/b][/p][p]While PWA tirelessly produces content for you on his YouTube channel and helps grow our community, I’ve taken on the role of developer and game designer.[/p][p]Tackling a project like [i]Countryballs: The Heist [/i]solo and without major financial backing is, to put it mildly, ambitious. But in 2023, I decided to take the leap: quit my job, found [i]pterix GmbH[/i], and work full-time on [i]Countryballs: The Heist[/i].[/p][p]To put every cent into the project, I’ve gone without a salary from day one, living off side projects and savings. Moving back to my parents’ place in the countryside is probably one of the less cool moves I’ve made recently...[/p][p]Honestly, this game has long since become more than just my new job. It’s become a part of me.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Why we need more time[/b][/p][p]Admittedly, it’s partly the little details that are stretching out the development. But I’m convinced those exact details will make [i]Countryballs: The Heist [/i]a unique experience. On the other hand, a one-person development is incredibly hard to plan... unexpected things happen during development – and in life.[/p][p]Most importantly, we don’t want to hand you a half-baked game despite all the challenges.
We’re taking the time to make [i]Countryballs: The Heist [/i]a game that both we and you can be proud of on release day. Whether GTA 6 will release before or after [i]The Heist[/i]? Phew... only the Countryball gods – or Rockstar – know that...[/p][p][/p][p][b]How you can help now[/b][/p][p]From the bottom of my heart, thank you for your support, your trust – and especially for wishlisting [i]Countryballs: The Heist [/i]on Steam.
Since we’re independent, every wishlist truly counts. It’s the only way we have a real chance of being noticed on Steam.[/p][p][/p][h3]So here’s our humble request:
Please share [i]Countryballs: The Heist [/i]with your friends and on social media.[/h3][p][/p][p]Thank you!
Now I’m grabbing a tea and getting back to coding.[/p][p]Yours,
mnenad - the developer[/p]

notes.title: The Special Shape Forces Joined the Heist!
notes.notes:
In addition to over 250 playable CountryBALLS, some new, non-spherical characters are now joining the crazy heists as well. In this news article, we introduce you to these quirky characters and explain why these nations each showcase a unique shape.

Oh, and don’t forget to celebrate your excitement for Countryballs: The Heist with a free Community Avatar: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1986290/Avatar/List?snr=1_5_9_]Click here to access the Community Avatars[/url]

[h3]Our first candidate is Chile:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004425/bc2da4226c60aca614769ecbef2fb1a2e4c46e76.jpg[/img]

Chile’s elongated, snake-like shape is evident from a glance at a world map. The country is squeezed between the Pacific Ocean to the west and the Andes Mountains to the east, stretching over 4,300 km (2,672 miles) along the South American continent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004425/d5569601055cc392032283a594fa1689bd93a88c.jpg[/img]

Another unique feature: The Spanish spoken in Chile is markedly different from Spanish in other countries – stretching the limits of linguistic possibilities to the max.
________

[h3]Israel as a semi-transparent cube:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004425/a8f410ac7202cc8d1eda9d8a7b396f6809c75476.jpg[/img]

Why a cube?
The answer: 'Jewish Physics'…

In the 1930s, Germany saw the rise of the absurd doctrine of 'German Physics,' which rejected and disparaged the theory of relativity and quantum mechanics as 'Jewish Physics.' An early Countryball comic picks up on this and has the scientifically gifted Israel discover that Countryballs are actually 4-dimensional hypercubes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004425/a7e04b3934e8297c2adf5fb83052238cd62c3b07.jpg[/img]

And why is it slightly transparent? Because Israel is not recognized by a significant number of United Nations (UN) member states, particularly in the Middle East. In their view, Israel doesn't exist (invisible), while the majority of member states clearly see it as a sovereign state. A mix of both perspectives contributes to Israel's semi-transparent appearance.
________

[h3]Kazakhbrick:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004425/e96454f0a35b334cb7d8e87f4b7bab410a05cd60.jpg[/img]

There are two popular theories about the shape of Kazakhstan.

Theory 1: The Countryball phenomenon famously began on the internet platform Krautchan, where, alongside user names, a country flag icon was displayed. When these flags were later transformed into Countryballs, Kazakhstan was simply overlooked and retained its rectangular flag shape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004425/84e36e5e571d22d33656e4a36b0e3cfa87784a07.jpg[/img]

Theory 2: The English word 'brick' sounds similar to the acronym for the rapidly growing economies BRIC(S) (Founding states: Brazil, Russia, India, China). Kazakhstan would also like to be part of these economic powers – so having a fitting appearance can’t hurt.
________

[h3]Nepalrawr![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004425/3f4f1222a89c834ff61e4c86be1278585be361f0.jpg[/img]

With a bit of imagination, the world’s most uniquely shaped flag resembles a gaping dragon’s mouth. Nepal’s old flag from 1774 even had fringes that looked like hundreds of needle-sharp tiny teeth – true nightmare material.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004425/6bc4061594c202a523966f6c8904c775165234bb.jpg[/img]

Another plausible explanation attributes the flag’s frightening appearance to the fear of the monstrous Himalayan mountains, from which the roaring thunder of storms, avalanches, and NepalRAAAAWR echoes.
________

[h3]Pana
Ma:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004425/a7569f5e0b95de96efb2b8105f95e74dfbca721f.jpg[/img]

Panama takes the concept of 'being in two minds' quite literally. Not only does the country connect the continents of North and South America, but the construction of the 82 km (51 miles) long Panama Canal has effectively divided it into two halves. Accordingly, the countryball is also split horizontally.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004425/e7678fdf5503f985e6fbc544f910d8a390fdd023.jpg[/img]
________

[h3]Singa… uh… Tringapore:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004425/cbdc89ad0601049b5a5fa5cc4bce858c24b1a1e9.jpg[/img]

The reason why Singapore is depicted as a triangle is not entirely clear. 
Some sources refer to the "Growth Triangle" of Indonesia-Malaysia-Singapore, an economic alliance aimed at making the region more attractive to investors.

Other sources point to the three largest ethnic groups in the country (Chinese, Malays, Indians) or claim that 'Tringapore' seems more cheerful compared to the solitary and less happy connotation of 'single'.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004425/0da14a22036f6f51b75861f4fe492bec5ca7b25f.jpg[/img]

Well, we can't help but love Singapore when it looks so cute.

[b]In the finished game Countryballs: The Heist, you’ll discover fascinating facts about every country around the world. So, it’s definitely worth adding to your wishlist![/b]

Thank you very much.
